effect.black-white: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.
effect.black-2-white-2: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

short_effect.black-white: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
short_effect.black-2-white-2: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.

flavor_text.black-white: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.
